title: Tor-independent tensor comparison for a bounded projective complex
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and let A and B be commutative R-algebras. Write Tor_i^R(-,-) for the usual projective-resolution Tor groups [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], and assume Tor_i^R(A,B)=0 for every i>0. Put E=A\otimes_R B. Let Q^\bullet be a bounded cochain complex of A-modules whose terms are finite projective A-modules (each is a direct summand of A^m for some finite m), and let D be a localization of E. Writing Q^\bullet\otimes_R^L B for the left-derived tensor product and Q^\bullet\otimes_A D for the ordinary tensor complex, the canonical map H^i(Q^\bullet\otimes_R^L B)\otimes_E D \longrightarrow H^i(Q^\bullet\otimes_A D) is an isomorphism for every i.
